raw_prompt: !fix The giant pig does have 100 health, that works properly. But the size is just default.
reviewer_feedback: Updated the giant pig spawning script to correctly set the entity size to 5.0 using the proper Skript scale syntax.
usage_instructions: Use the command /spawnbigpig to summon a giant pig.
Requires operator permissions to execute the spawn command.

mutations.content:
command /spawnbigpig:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        spawn a pig at player
        set {_pig} to last spawned entity
        set max health of {_pig} to 100
        heal {_pig}
        # Using the correct Skript syntax for entity scaling
        set scale of {_pig} to 5.0
        send "&aSpawned a giant pig!" to player

traces.intent_summary: Adjust the size attribute of the giant pig entity to be larger than the default pig size.

traces.rationale: In modern Skript versions (supporting 1.20.5+), entity scaling is handled via the 'attribute scale' property rather than a generic 'scale' property. This ensures the entity's physical size is updated correctly in the game engine.

traces.error_trace:
[Skript] Reloading giant_pig.sk...
Line 9: (mobs\giant_pig.sk)
    Can't understand this condition/effect: set attribute scale of {_pig} to 5.0
    Line: set attribute scale of {_pig} to 5.0
 
[Skript] Encountered 1 error while reloading giant_pig.sk! (29ms)

traces.rationale: The error occurred because 'set attribute scale' is not a valid Skript syntax. The correct syntax for modifying entity size in modern Skript versions is simply 'set scale of <entity> to <number>'. I have updated the script to use this direct property setter.
